item.title: Self-Hosted 3D CAD Web Viewers: Online 3D Viewer vs OpenSCAD vs FreeCAD
item.description: Sharing 3D CAD models with team members, clients, or the public shouldn’t require everyone to install specialized software. Self-hosted 3D CAD web viewers let you serve interactive 3D models directly in the browser — no downloads, no licenses, instant access. In this guide, we compare three leading approaches: Online 3D Viewer (a dedicated web-based model viewer), OpenSCAD (programmatic CAD with web capabilities), and FreeCAD (full-featured parametric CAD with web export).
